summary: Sprint 3 (PLUGIN ARCHITECTURE + BLACKLIST AUTO-ALERT) fully verified — backend + frontend. New backend test suite /app/backend/tests/test_sprint3_plugins_blacklist.py = 14/14 PASSED in ~7s covering: (PLUGINS) GET /api/plugins returns exactly 10 plugins, anpr is core+enabled by default; PUT /api/plugins/anpr {enabled:false} -> 400 (core protection); PUT /api/plugins/ai_detection {enabled:true/false} works for admin and persists in DB across GET; non-admin (tech, client) get 403; unknown plugin id returns 404. (ANPR DETECT) POST /api/anpr/detect with 'ZZ-999-ZZ' -> list_status='black', blacklist_alert=true, and a new critical 'anpr_blacklist' alert appears in GET /api/alerts; with 'XY-111-ZW' -> list_status='none', blacklist_alert=false, alert count unchanged; detection record persisted in GET /api/plates; endpoint denies unauthenticated requests. (WEBSOCKET) admin /api/ws?token=... receives {type:'alert',data:{type:'anpr_blacklist',message:'...ZZ-999-ZZ'}} within ~1s after the REST detect call. (NON-REGRESSION) login admin/tech/client/viewer all 200 with /auth/me echo; client sees <=2 sites (site cloisonnement); X-Total-Count header present on /api/plates; dashboard /api/dashboard/stats returns real psutil keys (cpu/ram/storage/uptime_days); alert ack endpoint OK. Frontend Playwright: admin → /plugins shows 10 plugin-card, anpr toggle aria-checked=true, clicking plugin-toggle-ai_detection flips false->true with toast 'Détection IA (YOLO) activé' and survives a full page reload (PERSISTED). On /anpr Watchlist tab, anpr-sim-input='ZZ-999-ZZ' + anpr-sim-btn -> red toast 'ALERTE : plaque en liste noire détectée !' AND a parallel WS-driven toast 'Alerte: Plaque en liste noire détectée : ZZ-999-ZZ' (broadcast_alert reached the UI). Normal plate 'XY-111-ZW' -> green toast 'Détection enregistrée'. Switching to Plates tab shows plates-count went 80->90, top rows include both ZZ-999-ZZ and XY-111-ZW. Role gating for nav-plugins verified in Layout.jsx (entry guarded by role:'admin' -> only admin renders it; tech/client/viewer hidden by the existing can(role) filter).

minor.issue: Aggressive in-memory rate-limit on /api/auth/login (security.py SENSITIVE_LIMITS) bites the existing regression suite (backend_test.py logs in once per test class -> 429 after ~5 classes). Sprint 3 suite is safe because logins are scoped to module fixtures. Consider either: (a) increasing limit window for /auth/login when CORS_ORIGINS includes the preview domain, or (b) adding a small Retry-After loop in backend_test.py _login() helper. Not a Sprint 3 regression.
Carried over from iter6: AlertCreate.site_id is still ignored — site_id derived from chosen camera. Not blocking Sprint 3.

issues: Plate badges render with a leading country glyph prefix (e.g. 'FZZ-999-ZZ') because the flag emoji 'F' is concatenated with the plate string in some rendering paths. Cosmetic — likely the country indicator collapsed when flag font is missing. Confirm intended visual or split flag glyph from plate text in plate-badge component.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Raise per-IP login rate-limit or scope it by user-agent/session so the full regression suite can run back-to-back without 429s.
(OPTIONAL, carry-over) Honor AlertCreate.site_id when camera_id is empty (or drop the field).
(COSMETIC) Verify plate-badge flag prefix rendering ('FZZ-999-ZZ' shown in plates list) — split the country flag glyph from the plate string so the badge reads 'ZZ-999-ZZ' alone.
critical_code_review_comments: plugins.py is_enabled() reads from Mongo on EVERY request — fine at low traffic but the catalog rarely changes. Consider a 5-30s in-process TTL cache to cut a DB roundtrip on hot ANPR detect path. Cache must be invalidated on PUT /api/plugins/{id}.

plugins.py seed_plugins inserts {enabled: p['id']=='anpr'} only if the doc is missing. New entries added to PLUGIN_CATALOG later will be seeded on next boot, but EXISTING docs are never updated when name/description/version/category/core fields change in code. Consider an upsert that merges static manifest fields (name, description, version, category, core) while preserving the user's enabled flag.

plugins.py toggle_plugin: a non-existent plugin gets a 404, but trying to ENABLE a plugin that is not in PLUGIN_CATALOG (only in DB) is not validated. Low risk but worth a sanity check against PLUGIN_CATALOG ids.

routers.py anpr_detect: cam = first camera in DB when camera_id is empty — exposes admin's first camera site_id/lat/lng to clients via the response. Acceptable for a simulation endpoint but for production, require camera_id or restrict to cameras allowed by site_scope.

routers.py maybe_blacklist_alert: alert.id uuid4 + insert_one then pop _id — fine; broadcast_alert is awaited (not background). If broadcast manager has many subscribers this serializes the response — consider firing into BackgroundTasks like send_notification.

routers.py anpr_detect computes wl = await db.watchlist.find_one({'plate': plate}) BUT the watchlist plate is stored uppercased on insert (line 371). Detect already uppercases plate before lookup -> OK. Just add an index on watchlist.plate to keep this O(1) when blacklist grows.

Plugins.jsx Switch uses disabled={!isAdmin || p.core} but the rendered DOM did not expose a `disabled` or `aria-disabled` attribute when inspected via Playwright — Radix Switch sometimes sets data-disabled instead. UX-wise the core anpr toggle visually still appears interactive. Consider adding a tooltip 'Plugin cœur — non désactivable' on the disabled switch for clarity.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 sprint3) + ~90% regression (27/30 — 3 pre-existing TestANPR/TestAI/TestTwoFA setup failures due to /auth/login 429 from heavy parallel runs)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin nav-plugins shown, 10 plugin-cards, ai_detection toggle persists across reload with success toast, ZZ-999-ZZ shows blacklist error toast + WS broadcast toast, XY-111-ZW success toast, both detections appear at top of Plates tab)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 3 backend suite: /app/backend/tests/test_sprint3_plugins_blacklist.py — runs in ~7s under pytest.ini's -n 2 --dist loadscope. Uses websockets 16.0 (already installed). Reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env if not in env. rca of the issue: No new Sprint 3 issues. Carry-over notes: (1) login rate-limit (security.py SENSITIVE_LIMITS) is in-memory per-IP -> across full regression cycle, the preview IP hits limit and existing backend_test.py classes fail at setup with 429.
